name: io.github.Fistacho/ha-nexus-agent
title: Nexus Agent
description: MCP server for Home Assistant: entities, automations, dashboards, ESPHome, energy, HACS

environmentVariables.name: HA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Home Assistant instance, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123

environmentVariables.name: HA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Home Assistant long-lived access token (Profile -> Security -> Long-Lived Access Tokens)

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true = read-only mode: every tool not annotated read-only, including generic service calls, is hidden and refused by the server

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_DISABLED_NAMESPACES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool namespaces to hide and refuse, e.g. files,git,supervisor (an unknown name stops startup)
